title: 新加坡湯申—東海岸線
summary: 以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。
summaryEn: Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量與互斥進路與真值驗證
stages.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work & Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Possession window and achievable work" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Possession window and achievable work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把延伸線接續窗口分為隔離、施工、測試及還路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工窗口與可完成工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Split the extension connection window into isolation, construction, testing and handback. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Possession window and achievable work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Possession window and achievable work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量
knowledge.text: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。
knowledge.textEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「新加坡湯申—東海岸線」的「施工窗口與可完成工作量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Possession window and achievable work: mechanism and system paths” in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Possession window and achievable work" is correct?
options: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量
夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Possession window and achievable work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 50.49 min，其餘固定，結果為 538.04 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 50.49 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 538.04 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 50.49 min，其餘固定，結果為 538.04 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 50.49 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 538.04 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Possession window and achievable work", which statement holds?
options: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min。
optionsEn: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Possession window and achievable work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。
knowledge.textEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Possession window and achievable work"?
options: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Possession window and achievable work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把延伸線接續窗口分為隔離、施工、測試及還路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Split the extension connection window into isolation, construction, testing and handback.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。
knowledge.textEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對營運端與施工端建立明確互斥進路和隔離狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Establish explicit route exclusion and isolation states between operating and construction sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「互斥進路與真值驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。

Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.

knowledge.textEn: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對營運端與施工端建立明確互斥進路和隔離狀態。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
